queries: WITH t AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(CAST(w AS REAL) / NULLIF(g, 0)) AS avg_win_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id) SELECT team_id, avg_win_rate, record_count, avg_win_rate - (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) FROM t) AS diff_from_mean FROM t ORDER BY (avg_win_rate - (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) FROM t)) IS NULL, diff_from_mean DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Teams are grouped by team_id alone, across all years, rather than by team and year.
Record count is the number of all manager_half rows for the team, including rows whose win rate is missing (null w or g, or g = 0, which is treated as missing via NULLIF).
The overall mean is the unweighted mean of the per-team averages, not a mean over individual records.

responses.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(w * 1.0 / NULLIF(g, 0)) AS avg_win_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id) SELECT team_id, avg_win_rate, record_count, avg_win_rate - (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) FROM t) AS diff_from_mean FROM t ORDER BY (avg_win_rate - (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) FROM t)) IS NULL, diff_from_mean DESC, team_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Teams are grouped by team_id alone, so all years are combined. The record count is every manager_half row for the team, including rows whose win rate is missing.
A row with g = 0 has a missing win rate (the division is NULLIF'd), so it is ignored in the average.
Ties in the difference are broken by team_id ascending.

responses.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(1.0 * w / NULLIF(g, 0)) AS avg_win_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id) SELECT team_id, avg_win_rate, record_count, avg_win_rate - (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) FROM t) AS diff_from_mean FROM t ORDER BY (avg_win_rate - (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) FROM t)) IS NULL, diff_from_mean DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Teams are grouped by team_id alone, across all years and leagues, rather than by team and year.
A record with g = 0 has no defined win rate, so it is treated as missing (NULLIF) and skipped in the average. It is still counted in record_count.
The mean of all team averages is an unweighted mean over teams that have a non-null average, not over individual records.
